architecture.runtime: static site (GitHub Pages), ES modules with an import map, no build step; Node ≥ 20 for tests, Python 3 for data builds

modules.js/app.js: state, row scopes, panel modes, URL, camera, map clicks (selectOffice, filterOrg, setMetric)
modules.js/model.js: decode data/offices.json, measures (count | rent, RENT_MIN_N), filters, summaries, production/Transit links
modules.js/area-insight.js: first Aha for both measures (tie rule, N − 1, rail bars or rail medians, outside finding)
modules.js/profile-model.js: panel models: overview, area, station, building, office (compsetOf), organisation
modules.js/panel.js: HTML of every panel mode + the provenance line
modules.js/chart-model.js: chart models (areas by measure, district × category matrix, organisation ranking)
modules.js/provinces.js: province frames, measure fill below zoom 8, rent no_data hatch
modules.js/scales.js: LDS count + price 41-sample LUTs, rank ramps, EVID-05 classes
modules.js/pins.js: office symbols (one size), HTML pins with roving focus
modules.js/stations.js: rail stations and the 500 m radius
modules.js/massing.js: city and focus massing tiers; CityMETER Building V4 inside CityMETER units (shapeCmTile, planCmRequests), OSM parts override, context layer, credit
modules.js/shell/camera.js: presets, pitched fits and the building camera (terrain-aware: groundAt, projectAltitude)
modules.js/labels.js: names near the middle of the view (importance = floors + asking-rent percentiles), hover card of icon chips
modules.js/shell/terrain.js: terrain mode at hilly sites and round a building or office being looked at
modules.js/shell/building-units.js: buildings per area: the per-province unit files of Hotel 0.3.6 (data/building-units/), CityMETER zones, production tile URLs and the attribution

rowScopes.scopeRows: rows after search · category · evidence · floors · province · organisation, before any district selection or focus: the comparison base of the Aha, the choropleth, the charts and every rank
rowScopes.baseRows: scopeRows narrowed by the selected เขต/อำเภอ
rowScopes.rows: baseRows narrowed by the district focus: pins with detail, counters, the table (a building, station or organisation panel shows its own rows)
